why_best: Binding the typography directly against the device chassis visually reinforces the extreme thinness of the hardware by turning the headline itself into an exact physical dimension.
why_bad: Leaving the copy floating loosely in empty space alongside the product weakens the technical story, reducing a bold engineering claim to a generic floating subtitle.
trap: A near-miss will leave too much empty space between the type and the handset edge, treating the graphic like an external callout rather than a physical measurement bonded to the surface.
